form_analysis.feedback: Solid aftercare for a gentle chemical exfoliation. Clearly outlines the expected mild flaking and sensitisation period. Provides good guidance on sun protection and product avoidance to prevent irritation. Bridges the gap between a mild peel and a standard facial.

form_data.introduction: The following aftercare advice is important to care for your skin after its gentle exfoliation. Enzymes have worked to dissolve dead skin cells; your skin will now be slightly more sensitive and requires protective, soothing care.

instructions.general_directive: Please follow this aftercare advice to ensure a smooth recovery and reveal brighter, smoother skin.

sections.title: Immediate Post-Treatment Symptoms and Timeline
sections.content: Your skin may be pink and feel warm, tight, or slightly sensitive for 12-24 hours. Mild flaking or peeling, often described as a 'napkin peel,' may occur 2-4 days after treatment, primarily on the cheeks, forehead, and chin. This is normal and a sign the treatment is working.

sections.title: Cleansing and Product Use
items: Cleanse gently with a lukewarm water and a mild, non-foaming cleanser for the first 48 hours.
Do not use any other exfoliating products (retinol, AHA/BHA, scrubs) for 5-7 days.
Apply a soothing, hydrating moisturizer frequently to alleviate tightness and support the barrier.
If peeling occurs, DO NOT PICK OR PULL the skin. Allow it to shed naturally.

sections.title: Sun Protection - Critical
sections.content: Your new skin is more vulnerable to UV damage. You MUST apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher every morning for at least 1 week. Avoid direct sun exposure for 48 hours.

sections.title: Activity and Environmental Restrictions
items: Avoid heat-inducing activities (strenuous exercise, saunas, hot yoga, steam rooms) for 48 hours to minimise inflammation and flushing.
Avoid swimming in chlorinated pools or the sea for 48 hours.

sections.title: Makeup
sections.content: It is best to avoid makeup for 24 hours. When you resume, apply it gently. Flaking skin can make makeup application uneven; extra moisturizer can help create a smoother base.

sections.title: Hydration
sections.content: Drink plenty of water and use a hydrating serum or moisturizer to help plump the new skin cells from underneath.

sections.title: General Side Effects and Results Assessment
items: If you experience significant stinging, burning, or itching beyond 24 hours, discontinue all products and contact your therapist.
Once any peeling has finished (around day 4-5), your skin will appear brighter, smoother, and more even-toned.
Enzyme peels are gentle enough for regular use (e.g., every 2-4 weeks) to maintain results.
